questionPrompt: Some people think that environmental problems should be solved by governments, while others believe individuals should take responsibility. Discuss both views.
passageText: Although climate change is a serious problem, but governments are slow to act. Many countries have signed agreements, they have not followed through on their promises. While renewable energy is becoming cheaper however fossil fuels remain dominant.
